dedupe_keys.name: dreal auvergne rhone alpes flood hazard datasets

description: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Coverage: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The listing groups 34 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Enveloppes Approchées d'Inondations Potentielles des cours d'eau de Au; Données produites par le SIG Directive inondation du territoire à risq; Enveloppes Approchées d'Inondations Potentielles du Bassin Rhône Médit. Formats seen: SHAPEFILE, MAPINFO TAB. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
